meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: The binding ultrawork-mode directive. This file IS the directive; read it only when ultrawork mode is requested and the directive is not already in the conversation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按预设规则切换助手的工作模式,让它照你设定的方式执行任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让助手用一套固定指令改变自己的工作方式
copy.tagline_en: Switch the assistant into a preset work mode so it runs tasks your way
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want the assistant to change how it works via a fixed set of directives

howto.what: 开启 ultrawork 模式后,首行必须输出 ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!;Claude 以编码代理身份工作,先把目标和成功标准登记进 goal 工具,建持久记事本与待办清单,再交付经过真实表面验证的改动。
howto.when: 当你请求开启 ultrawork 模式、且这段指令还没出现在当前对话里时读取并接管。

say.text: 开启 ultrawork 模式,这个改动按 LIGHT 档做
用 ultrawork 模式修这个 bug,给我 RED→GREEN 证据
say.note: 会建记事本与待办清单,先抓失败优先证据

say.text: 切到 HEAVY 档,这次改动涉及 auth
say.note: 升档后走审查循环,直到无条件通过

howto.what_en: With ultrawork mode on, the first line must be exactly `ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!`. Claude then acts as an expert coding agent: it registers a goal, opens a durable notepad and todo list, and ships changes backed by real-surface evidence.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you request ultrawork mode and this directive is not already in the conversation.

say_en.text: Enable ultrawork mode and take the LIGHT tier for this change
say_en.note: First line prints ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!, then a goal is registered

say_en.text: Use ultrawork mode to fix this bug and give me RED->GREEN evidence
say_en.note: A notepad and todo list get created

say_en.text: Switch to HEAVY tier; this touches auth code
say_en.note: Tier upgrades and a reviewer loop runs
